# KGR Enterprises — Invisible Grills & Safety Nets

> KGR Enterprises installs invisible grills, balcony safety nets, pigeon nets and sports nets for homes, apartments and commercial buildings in Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam. In business since 2010, with 4000+ installations completed and a 10-year warranty.

## Key facts

- Business: KGR Enterprises (also known as KGR Invisible Grills & Safety Nets)
- Founded: 2010
- Installations completed: 4000+
- Cities served: Bangalore (Karnataka), Hyderabad (Telangana), Chennai (Tamil Nadu), Vijayawada (Andhra Pradesh), Visakhapatnam (Andhra Pradesh), Guntur (Andhra Pradesh)
- Invisible grills price: ₹145 per sq ft, installation included
- Invisible grill material: SS316 marine-grade stainless steel cable, nylon coated
- Warranty: 10 years
- Typical installation time: 4–6 hours for an apartment balcony
- Site inspection and quotation: free
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91-93373 53030, +91-96185 68669
- Email: kgr.invisiblegrills.nets@gmail.com
- Hours: Mon–Sat 8:00 AM–8:00 PM, Sun 9:00 AM–6:00 PM (IST)

## Invisible Grills

- [Invisible Grills](https://invisiblegrillsandsafetynets.in/invisible-grills/): Invisible grill installation service for balconies and windows using premium stainless steel cables. Enjoy unobstructed views, child-safe protection, and reliable anti-theft performance.
- [Invisible Grill for Balcony](https://invisiblegrillsandsafetynets.in/invisible-grills-balcony/): Invisible balcony grill installation that preserves your view while protecting children, pets, and property from falls and intruders.

- [Ceiling Cloth Drying Hangers](https://invisiblegrillsandsafetynets.in/cloth-drying/): Smart space-saving cloth drying hangers for modern homes. Dry clothes indoors with a durable ceiling-mounted system built for apartments and compact spaces.
